verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so hosted invoicing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only adjacent features: Smartlink payment links, a hosted payment button and recurring or scheduled charges. No evidence item mentions invoice creation, hosted invoice pages or automatic payment reminders, and payment links and recurring charges are different capabilities from invoicing with reminders.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
